title: Sheinbaum Signs Decree Barring Dual Nationals from Presidency and Governorships from 2028
detail: At her Oct 7 conference Sheinbaum signed the decree implementing the constitutional reform that bars people with dual nationality from running for president or governor starting in 2028; the reform passed both chambers and 22 state congresses, and publication in the Diario Oficial was expected that evening. CFE presented the Chicoasén II hydroelectric project and a plan to end blackouts on the Yucatán Peninsula. She also marked Morena's anniversary, saying governors of the movement should uphold honesty.
